description: Verify Wave2 produced a cross-topic synthesis artifact: synthesis file exists and is non-empty, contains at least one Markdown link referencing a Wave0 or Wave1 artifact, at least one reference target actually exists in the bundle, trace evidence present, status values point to wave2→hitl2.

rules.failure_message: Missing file: artifacts/wave2/synthesis.md. Derive a cross-topic synthesis from verified Wave0 and Wave1 artifacts.
artifacts/wave2/synthesis.md is empty. Write a cross-topic synthesis that references Wave0 and Wave1 artifacts.
No valid artifact references found in synthesis. Add at least one Markdown link (e.g. [label](../wave1/topic-a/skeleton.md)) that points to an existing Wave0 or Wave1 artifact file in the bundle.
Missing trace event: wave2_completion. The phase body requires recording this event in rb_trace.jsonl before running the gate.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'wave2_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'hitl2_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
